create_parser_config: create a ParserConfig instance to configure how a JSON trace file is parsed
clone_parser_config: clone an existing ParserConfig to create a deep copy for safe modification
enable_communication_args: enable communication-related attribute specs on a ParserConfig for parsing network events
infer_attribute_specs: infer AttributeSpec definitions from a pandas Series of trace event argument dictionaries
set_default_cfg: set a custom ParserConfig as the global default for all subsequent trace parsing operations
